name: Bop It!
summary:
Bop It! is a digital adaptation of the classic action-reaction game where players follow voice commands to perform quick movements like tapping, twisting, spinning, flicking, or swiping the on-screen controls. The game challenges players to respond accurately and rapidly before time runs out.

It features multiple solo modes—including Classic, Basic, Extreme, and Blitz—that vary in difficulty and pace. Multiplayer options allow for competitive or cooperative play with friends across different game types. As players advance, additional commands and interactive “Bopjects” become available, adding complexity to the gameplay.
